name: Bon Bonheur
source:
"People eat to live. But we live without eating."

"If so why, do we eat. That could be the pleasure of infinite intellect."

A genuine Hanabito living in Parterdeame.

A cooking researcher of gourmet food

[from [url=http://cannonette.tumblr.com/post/106205748442/reine-des-fleurs-side-characters-part-2]cannonette[/url]]
